_note_master_pdf: qmhp_master_pdf_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the frozen v1.5.8f Master PDF used to prepare QMHP-CEM_v0.1_Spec.md, carried verbatim from spec section 2.4. The PDF itself is not vendored in this repository. If the project later adopts a different rendered byte sequence as the canonical frozen Master, update this digest ONLY after explicitly verifying and recording the replacement. Do not silently substitute it.
